reviews.comment: Professor Henderson is the best! She makes lectures interesting and includes all students never letting anyone feel left out. She wants the class to get to know each other and business and she does a great job! Definitely recommend her for business 403!

A&M makes you take a First Year Experience and I loved the professor that I chose. Professor Henderson was such a sweet and genuine person! As long as you show up to the online class and turn your camera on you get a 100 for your participation grade. You are given barely any assignments that count for a grade. She is a pretty insightful prof.
